title: Assistance Plan Write V1 (the answer to a create or a revision)
$comment: DL-KB-07. POST /api/projects/{id}/assistance-plans and POST .../revisions answer with this envelope, whose `plan` member is the stored revision document exactly as the writer validated it. `stored: true` is a statement about this request only: the bytes are in the state database and readable through the detail route. It is not a statement that a model produced the plan, that any external step ran, or that a reference was analysed -- those are separate facts the readback reports with their own evidence.
